claim_boundary: one domain, one engine; nothing here establishes general recursive self-improvement

hypotheses.H1: held-out tasks solved by `open` exceed those of the CIRCUIT1 lineage, same seeds, tasks and budget (paired; the mean must be higher), and the number of components proposed per step does not fall with generations. Refuted otherwise
hypotheses.H2a: learning tasks gained by `learned2` exceed those gained by `explore` (random ranking), paired over family group and seed, exact one-sided sign test at 0.05. Refuted otherwise
hypotheses.H2b: `learned2` gains at least as much as `learned1` on average, and `learned2` at least as much as `support`
hypotheses.diagnostic: area under the curve of each ranker for 'the trial gains a task' on the explore trials of its target group

name: CIRCUIT2
ranker: ridge regression (penalty 1) of the clipped gain in learning tasks on thirteen features of a proposed component; fitted only on explore trials of other family groups, all seeds
reading: H2 is the test of the second-order criterion in its simplest form: experience of improving, gathered elsewhere, makes improving more productive, and more experience makes it more productive still. The ranker's form and features are written by hand; only its weights are learnt
stopping_rule: a lineage ends at the first step that keeps no component, or at the generation limit
